families.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

members.gloss: having no meaning or direction or purpose
members.tone: Plain on the surface and bleak underneath, since it withholds direction and purpose along with sense, condemning where *nonmeaningful* only records.

members.gloss: having no meaning or direction or purpose
members.tone: Colourless and technical, it notes the absence and adds no dismay to it, where *meaningless* sounds the loss.
A deflating verdict rather than a scornful one, saying only that nothing of weight is there and leaving the sneer to *vacuous*.
The outward form is intact and the inside is not, so it carries a ring of sham that flat *empty* does not.
The withering member of the three: formal, and it treats the missing force as a fault rather than a fact.
A cool dismissal of what a thing stands for rather than of its size or loudness, drier and less final than *nonsensical*.

members.gloss: lacking the thinking capacity characteristic of a conscious being
members.tone: Descriptive rather than damning in this sense, stating an absence of thinking capacity without laying blame, where *nonsensical* passes judgement on what was produced.
Blunt and unadorned, refusing the thing any intelligible sense without softening the refusal.
The fuller, more formal judgement that nothing can be made of the thing at all, weightier in the mouth than blunt *nonsense*.
The plainest statement in the family, that meaning is simply absent, with none of the scorn *vacuous* or *nonsensical* carry.
The broadest approval here, covering a disposition, a sign or an outcome alike, and unlike *approving* it never requires the approval to be spoken.
The British spelling, carrying exactly the force of *favorable* and adding nothing to it.

members.gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
members.tone: The plain word for approval that shows — in a look, a tone or a word — where *favorable* can stay unexpressed.

members.gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
members.tone: Cooler than *approving*: the praise arrives as endorsement, stated rather than warmly felt.

members.gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
members.tone: Formal to the point of stiffness — the same praise as *approving* lifted into an official register.

members.gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
members.tone: A near-twin of *approbative* in force, ceremonious enough that the praise reads as conferred rather than simply shown.

members.gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
members.tone: Literary and heightened, its praise closer to applause than to the bare assent of *affirmative*.
The mildest of these — a leaning in someone's favour rather than praise of any kind, so nothing need be expressed as it must with *approving*.

families.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

members.tone: The elastic member: it stretches from merely spoiled to flattened, so it fixes that ruin happened without fixing how much is left, where *annihilated* leaves nothing to measure.
Absolute where *destroyed* is elastic - it admits no remnant and no degree, and its sweep makes the ruin sound total rather than merely thorough.
Carries a purpose *annihilated* does not: the completeness is somebody's work, and the word frames what it names as a thing that was to be got rid of.
The informal member, and the offhand phrasing makes the same completeness sound quick and easy rather than momentous beside *annihilated*.

members.gloss: affected by blight; anything that mars or prevents growth or prosperity
members.tone: Ruin as a slow affliction rather than an event - what it marks is not smashed but stopped, held back from growing or prospering again.

members.gloss: affected by blight; anything that mars or prevents growth or prosperity
members.tone: British in spelling and the milder half of its pair: the good has gone out of the thing, where *blighted* adds that nothing will come of it now.
Nothingness reached by covering over: the thing is effaced rather than smashed, which makes this the visual member beside the formal *obliterated*.
The bare adjectival form states the finished nothingness flatly, without the backward glance at whatever caused it that *obliterated* keeps.
Formal and cold next to *blotted out*: the participle points back at an act, and what is left is nothing at all rather than something hidden.
Financial ruin in the bluntest available word - a single snap rather than a decline, and it reports the loss without blaming the one it fell on.
The formal word for that same ruin: it names the poverty left behind rather than the break itself, so it sounds like a settled condition where *broken* sounds like a moment.

members.gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire
members.tone: Reaches from scorched to gone, fixing fire as the cause while leaving open how much survives - which the compounds beside it refuse to leave open.

members.gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire
members.tone: The clipped form, and the shorter shape makes it read as a property the thing now has rather than a report of what happened to it, as *burned* does.

members.gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire
members.tone: The particle puts the fire's passage across the thing: it names what the flames swept and left behind them, not what they consumed.

members.gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire
members.tone: Says the fire went to its end from the inside and left a hollow behind - more final than plain *burned*, and short of gone.

members.gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire
members.tone: The clipped twin of *burned-out*, its tighter shape making the hollowness sound like the thing's condition now rather than the fire's doing.

families.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

members.tone: The family's flat baseline: it registers that an attack could land without saying anything is missing or anyone is at fault.

members.gloss: not defended or capable of being defended
members.tone: Formal and analytic, looking from the attacker's side at what can be gone after, where *undefended* only reports what is not there.

members.gloss: not defended or capable of being defended
members.tone: Puts the weight on impossibility - not that defences are absent but that none could be made to hold.

members.gloss: not defended or capable of being defended
members.tone: Bare report of an absence, with no claim that defence was tried or that it could have worked.

members.gloss: not defended or capable of being defended
members.tone: The mildest wording for the same state, naming the gap as a plain fact of position rather than the failure *undefendable* implies.

members.gloss: vulnerable to danger especially of discredit or suspicion
members.tone: The one member whose danger is to standing rather than to body - exposure that invites suspicion and discredit.
Pitying - the subject is helpless and unsupplied, where *undefended* notes only the absence.
British spelling, identical in force: helplessness rather than the neutral gap *undefended* reports.

members.gloss: (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
members.tone: A graded status term rather than a verdict, and the severe end of that grading - extinction imminent, not merely likely.

members.gloss: not able to be protected against attack
members.tone: Absolute here: no protection could hold, a harder claim than *undefended*'s report that none is in place.
Treats the exposure as a standing property of the thing's condition, an adverse mark rather than a neutral gap.
The blunt everyday form of the same adverse judgement, stating the danger without locating the weakness as *insecure* does.
Purely a property of the barrier - it says what can be got through, with no suggestion that anything is coming through.

members.gloss: (of flora or fauna) likely in the near future to become endangered
members.tone: The graded step below *endangered*: likelihood of peril soon rather than peril arrived.

members.gloss: subjected to enemy attack or censure
members.tone: Shifts from susceptibility to fact - the blows are landing, and they can be censure as readily as weapons.

members.gloss: subjected to enemy attack or censure
members.tone: The vivid twin of *under attack*, its gunfire image carrying the same double reach over assault and criticism.

families.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

members.tone: The flattest word here - it grants that attention is held and says nothing about how hard, which *absorbing* and *riveting* both do.

members.gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention
members.tone: The hold is inward and quiet, attention drawn in rather than seized as by *gripping*.

members.gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention
members.tone: Stronger than *absorbing*: attention is not merely drawn in but wholly occupied, with nothing left over.

members.gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention
members.tone: The hold works like a spell - attention is charmed into staying rather than pinned there as by *riveting*.

members.gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention
members.tone: Physical in its force - attention is taken hold of rather than invited, where *fascinating* wins it.

members.gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention
members.tone: The most immobilising of these - attention is fixed in place, not merely drawn in as by *absorbing*.
Light approval - it promises agreeable diversion rather than the deep hold *engrossing* claims.
Warm and easy - the praise is for the pleasure given, not for any grip on attention of the kind *gripping* asserts.
The stiffer, more formal shape beside *amusing*, claiming the same pleasure with less warmth in the saying.
Understated praise - the enjoyment is framed as a pleasant turning-aside, milder than *amusing*.

members.gloss: capable of arousing interest or curiosity
members.tone: The pull is curiosity rather than pleasure - it promises something not yet given, where *fascinating* holds you with what it shows.

members.gloss: sufficiently interesting to be reported in a newspaper
members.tone: A threshold rather than a compliment - it measures whether interest clears the bar for reporting, where the rest of the family reports the pull itself.

families.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

members.gloss: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task
members.tone: The flat general word for falling short of what a task demands, registering the shortfall without turning it on whoever bears it.

members.gloss: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task
members.tone: Weighs what is brought against what the task takes and finds the two mismatched, where *inadequate* names the shortfall as a defect in the thing itself.
Cool and quantitative - a measured shortfall below the amount or degree required, with none of the verdict *wanting* carries.
The plainest of these, naming the missing amount outright and stopping there.
Formal and weighted, as though the amount had been tested against a standard and pronounced short, where *lacking* only reports the gap.
Puts the unmet requirement down to capacity - not that the standard was missed but that it could not be reached.
The harshest here, reading a missed requirement as a verdict on fitness rather than a measurement of it.
The gentlest way of saying the requirement went unmet, setting the demand beside the resource and leaving the failure unassigned where *incompetent* pins it.

members.gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.
members.tone: Informal, and it carries the strain of working a job with too few hands rather than the bare count.

members.gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.
members.tone: States the shortfall as a plain condition of the staff on hand, neither excusing it nor blaming anyone for it.

members.gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.
members.tone: Measures the people present against the strength the work was meant to have, framing the gap as a post held by too few.

members.gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.
members.tone: The flattest of the four - a headcount below requirement, without the felt pressure of *short-handed*.

families.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

members.tone: A flat measure of weight in effect or meaning, asserting that something counts without saying the counting is welcome.
More insistent than *significant* — it claims the thing matters and should be treated accordingly, not merely that it registers.
Lifts *significant* to a height where the weight itself is the point, grave and admiring at once.

members.gloss: highly significant or important especially bringing about or marking the beginning of a new development or era
members.tone: Adds a boundary to the weight: not just great effect but the opening of something new, which *momentous* never requires.

members.gloss: highly significant or important especially bringing about or marking the beginning of a new development or era
members.tone: The active twin of *epochal* — it credits the thing with making the new beginning rather than merely marking it.

members.gloss: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world
members.tone: Trades gravity for reach — the effect is felt across the whole world, and the word keeps the physical jolt of its image.

members.gloss: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world
members.tone: The same global reach as *earthshaking*, with the world named outright instead of shaken underfoot.

members.gloss: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world
members.tone: The most violent of the three: the world does not shake but breaks, so the significance arrives as rupture.

members.gloss: serving as or based on evidence
members.tone: Carries no appraisal at all — it marks only that something rests on or supplies evidence, so it sits outside any scale of weight.

members.gloss: serving as or based on evidence
members.tone: The stiffer, more formal twin of *evidential*, and just as free of praise or blame.

members.gloss: far-reaching and thoroughgoing in effect especially on the nature of something
members.tone: Points downward rather than upward: the effect reaches what a thing is, describing depth of change instead of how much it is admired.

members.gloss: far-reaching and thoroughgoing in effect especially on the nature of something
members.tone: Where *fundamental* is structural this one is grave, reaching the same way into a thing's nature but spoken with awe.

members.gloss: fairly large or important in effect; influential
members.tone: Deliberately unemphatic — it grants real effect and influence while stopping far short of *monumental*.
Makes the significance imposing, something that stands over whatever is beside it, where *noteworthy* only asks you to look.
A modest claim: it asks for attention and promises nothing beyond it.
Stronger than *noteworthy* on the same ground — attention is compelled rather than merely deserved, and admiration comes with it.

families.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

members.tone: The plain, unemphatic name for the fault - it marks a failure to hold together without saying how sharp the clash is.
Idiomatic and comparatively mild - it frames the disagreement as two things standing opposed rather than as either one being wrong.
Puts the two sides in active collision, stronger than *at odds* but stopping short of claiming they cannot both stand.
The hardest of the disagreement words - it says the two cancel each other, so one of them has to go.
Turns the clash inward so no second party is needed - the thing defeats itself, which is the more damning charge.
Formal and measuring - it registers the mismatch against the facts coolly, where *incompatible* pronounces on it.
States the mismatch as a settled property of the thing rather than an observation about it, blunter and more final than *discrepant*.
Informal and deflating - it breaks the thing into good patches and bad ones, so the complaint carries a grudging concession inside it.
The mildest of these - it registers variation without deciding that any part of the thing has failed.
Informal and slighting - it allows the thing no smooth stretch at all, where *spotty* at least grants good patches between the bad.
Technical and unblaming - it records only that two things fail to correspond and leaves the fault unassigned.
Points at work left undone rather than at a defect - the clash simply stands, not declared unresolvable as *incompatible* would have it.
